rule: Walls of colour 8 form lattices of rooms. One-cell gaps flanked by wall are doors. Two rooms are prefilled with a colour. Every room on the door-linked chain between them is filled with that colour, along with every door the chain uses. If the chain crosses the open background between structures, only the bounding-box stripe between the entry and exit cells is filled there.
scope: Fill the unique door-connected route between two coloured rooms, painting only the entry/exit stripe when crossing open space. One or two path lattices of rectangular rooms plus optional distractor lattice, missing boundary rooms and clipping. Random scenes now include attached dead-end branches. Exact native dimensions 10..30, single/double layout, fill colour, branch flag and D4 transform are controllable.

authored_scope: Supported: one or two path lattices (room sizes 2..5, possibly different per lattice), clipping at the grid border, missing boundary rooms, an optional unconnected distractor lattice, extra distractor doors between off-path rooms, and in single-lattice scenes off-path doors to the outside. Scenes are built in a canonical frame and then dihedrally transformed. With two lattices the exit doors face each other across a gap of at least 2 cells, so there is exactly one crossing of the open area. Not supported: branching connectivity (ambiguous between path-fill and flood-fill readings), more than one open-area crossing, and irregular non-lattice walls. validate() rebuilds all four canonical pairs from explicit latent parameters (lattices, missing rooms, path nodes, door cells). The canonical and teaching data are identical, so no correction was applied.
authored_constraints: Every cell with wall on two opposite sides is an intended door, and every intended door has that property; there are no incidental doors.
Every visible lattice room is exactly one 4-connected non-wall, non-door component; rooms never merge.
Path nodes are distinct components; each path door joins exactly its two consecutive nodes.
Distractor doors join two off-path components only, so the path component is an unbranched chain.
Every path lattice room lies inside the bounding box of an 8-connected wall component (so it is filled completely).
The open-area node has cells outside every wall bounding box, and its entry/exit stripe consists entirely of open background.
Structures are separated by at least 2 cells along some axis (no 1-wide corridors, no 8-connected merging).
Exactly one fill colour, never 0 or 8; the output always differs from the input.
